neighbours.label: The word 'control' in descriptions of managing medical symptoms.
fire: The medication can control seizures in many patients.
Daily treatment helps control the symptoms of the disease.
Doctors adjusted the dosage to control her chronic pain.
The inhaler helps control asthma during exercise.
Surgery may provide complete control of the patient's seizures.
The new tablets control nausea after chemotherapy.
Careful monitoring helps control blood pressure after the operation.
The treatment is intended to control tremors in affected patients.
quiet: The medication can reduce seizures in many patients.
Daily treatment helps reduce the symptoms of the disease.
Doctors adjusted the dosage to relieve her chronic pain.
The inhaler helps manage asthma during exercise.
Surgery may provide complete relief from the patient's seizures.
The new tablets relieve nausea after chemotherapy.
Careful monitoring helps manage blood pressure after the operation.
The treatment is intended to reduce tremors in affected patients.
